sentences.text: I could not find any pre-payment instructions in the Gold Loan FAQ text provided, because the FAQ evidence here contains only the document title, date, and page/footer material, not any pre-payment guidance.
The only pre-payment wording in the evidence comes from other bank documents, which define pre-payment and foreclosure and state a pre-payment charge in the home loan agreement.

For RBI-style disclosure, the superseded directions said the applicability of pre-payment charges should be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and the current UCB directions say the same disclosure should be made there and, where applicable, in the KFS.
If you want a summary of the FAQ's own pre-payment instruction, I need the FAQ page or paragraph that actually contains that content.
